event_summary: A black kettlebell descends onto a white cup on a wooden tabletop, and the cup becomes flattened beneath it.
raw_event_description: At the start, a white cup-like object rests on its side near the center of a wooden table, with part of a black object visible near the top edge of the frame. The black object descends into view and is visible as a kettlebell marked "30 LB." It moves downward toward the cup, contacts the upper side of the cup, and continues lower while the cup visibly changes from a tilted cup shape into a flattened, folded shape. The kettlebell then remains upright over the flattened cup, with a black vertical strap or support visible above it.

reasons: The white cup and tabletop are clearly visible.
Only the lower part of a black object is visible at the top edge before it descends further.
